decision_clause: The active decision ruled out keeping lane counts as a floor because slack permits tests and allowlist entries to disappear undetected.
label: COMPLIANT
observable_behavior: The focused schema lanes require their observed passing-test counts to equal fixed values; the capability lane must run exactly 19 tests. The implementation does not accept any count at or above a lower bound.
rationale: Within the recorded four-path scope, the finished tree explicitly says the lane counts are exact, not floors, and enforces equality. Thus it stays outside the ruled-out floor-with-slack approach. Whether the separate proof-validation task is otherwise complete does not change this decision-boundary finding.
